_: A palette with one of every way a palette can be wrong, for case_content_data.
Deliberately broken. Every entry below except `fine` is a test of a specific refusal,
and if this file ever loads clean the palette registry has stopped enforcing something.

fine.use: a colour that obeys both laws

stale.use: obeys the law but claims to be excused from it
stale.why: there is no reason, which is the point

unjustified.use: breaks saturation, exempt, no why given

invented.use: exempt from a law that does not exist
invented.why: vibes is not one of the two laws

not_a_colour.use: six characters, none of them hex
